policy: No successor can be described as having fixed a predecessor failure merely because a related component was implemented or passed transport/unit tests. Require original failure mechanism, candidate-specific input evidence, consumer E2E, prospective opportunity/trade funnel and explicit release decision.

v2r4_snapshot.source: Supabase, 2026-10-09 ~17:15Z; two technical series, same strategy fingerprint

known_causal_facts: V2R3 near-zero conversion proven, but cause split among strategy selectivity, WAIT/lifecycle, incomplete feature evidence and true untradeability was not fully resolved.

V2R4 explicitly kept V2R3 major decision/filter roles and researched primarily earlier discovery and faster WAIT trigger/recheck. This was an intentionally limited timing comparison, NOT proven repair of low trade production.

Current candidate handoff includes percent returns/spread/turnover; paper_context supplies major BTC/ETH/SOL OHLC context but does not supply individual candidate's closed 1m/5m/15m candle/volume ratio/ATR/structural-stop features to the evaluator.
V2R3 HEALTHY refers to integrity and recording, NOT demonstrated sufficiency of all necessary trade decision inputs.
Missing coin evidence is a demonstrated wiring gap, NOT proven to be the sole or dominant causal reason for all REJECTs.
Subsequent MFE is not a directly tradeable profit; clusters by pair/time and adverse path/costs must be assessed.

latest_diagnostic_snapshot.source: Supabase public.paper_candidate_outcomes payload JSON; operator read-only physical proof 2026-10-09 ~20:44 Europe/Berlin. Data is a frozen research snapshot; live cohort can grow.

active_series_local_recheck_events.interpretation: Different local event count/time than Supabase latest unique outcome; one candidate can emit multiple recheck events, and cloud mirrors latest canonical outcome; never mix denominators.

post_trigger_reject_evidence_codes.caveat: Reason-code regex family matches are nonexclusive descriptive cautions, NOT proof of independent causal veto.

retrospective_followup_60min.interpretation: Measured from original decision and conditioned on later outcomes; selection-biased/correlated MFE, NOT live-entry performance, no validated net-fee profit; do not auto-loosen WAIT gates.

verified_claims: Strong prospectively defined ALL of 5m price recovery and closed-bar volume confirmation frequently expires before model recheck.
The low conversion is not only a pipeline failure: 22 triggered candidate rechecks occurred, but none produced BUY_SCOUT.

Candidate-specific proven per-coin closed-bar volume and ATR data were absent as a standard evaluator input for all 168 original decisions; a one-off real STRK/EUR model call with this info remained WAIT.
Expiry and actual model REJECT must never share a single apparent conversion denominator.
User-facing goal of economically viable quality Paper trades is unmet; do not claim solved or safe for real-money phase.
open_causality: No persisted per-scan nonmatch metric history to prove why each ALL gate failed; avoid inventing which conjunct blocked.
Post-trigger NO_BUY could be legitimately insufficient edge or insufficient structural-stop evidence; cannot attribute solely to missing coin evidence without prospective paired risk/cost comparison.
latest_diagnostic_snapshot.prioritized_successor_one_change_hypothe: First isolate point-in-time candidate-specific closed Kraken OHLC, volume, 15m ATR/structural low source into research evaluator inputs, while leaving timing conditions/fees/stop/size unchanged. Measure incremental valid BUY with risk/cost, false buys and 24h followups before any separate H4 trigger/TTL relaxation; honor frozen H3 baseline and its fixed review.

checks_before_any_successor_paper_releas.must_prove: Closed per-candidate Kraken OHLC, volume context and sufficient structural risk features with true observed_at/known_at; missing is UNKNOWN, no future leakage; existing source reused.
Actual scored candidate -> feature delivery -> full evaluator -> valid stop and stage2 plan under a controlled genuinely feasible setup, not only an isolated adapter unit test.
Fresh WAIT inputs can be consumed, trigger and TTL behavior measured, and recurrent WAIT-to-REJECT reasons distinguished with no unjustified auto-buy.

Incremental feasible BUY frequency or explicit evidenced rationale for no-buy; false positives, missed moves, costs incl 0.60% taker per side + spread/slippage, stop/MAE and data integrity compared by pair/time clustered cohort.

All predecessor significant failures have measured verified/retained/deferred/rejected disposition, V2R4 technical rotation isn't treated as new strategy, fixed H3 baseline remains preserved, human release decision separate.
